gloss: no matter what; by all means

definitions.gloss: no matter what; by all means; at any cost
definitions.explanation: Expresses strong determination to achieve something regardless of obstacles or circumstances. Emphasizes the speaker's unwavering resolve.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}が{何|なん}でも⟦{勝|か}ちたい→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: I want to win no matter what.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}が{何|なん}でも⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わらせる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll finish it by the end of today no matter what.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なに}が{何|なん}でも⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叶|かな}える→叶える：11807_kanaeru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He said he intended to make his dream come true no matter what.

notes:
USAGE:
Used to express strong resolve or insistence. Often appears before verbs of desire or intention such as ～たい, ～⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ, or ～⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧. Stronger and more emphatic than ⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧: by all means — similar meaning but slightly less emphatic
- ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: absolutely — expresses certainty or strong will, but lacks the "regardless of obstacles" nuance
- {是|ぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: at any cost — literary equivalent with similar force
